title: WP-BLD-D: shadow badf-build on every landed G07 self-dossier (badf-build -> SHADOWED)
objective: Turn BADF's own build history -- every landed work package carrying a G07 self-dossier -- into the shadow corpus of badf-build: examples/build-shadow-evidence.json records what the real tools render on that history (every indexed evidence artifact's digest recomputed at the landed tree; every demand replayed for C1; every typed binding's content tree recomputed; unit-test outcomes replayed against composition records for C5), and tests/test_badf_build_shadow.py recomputes every case from the object store on every run and refuses a tampered record. Controls with no historical corpus (C3 expected_surfaces, C4 test_obligations, C6 budget/stop, C7 delegations) are declared non-coverage, never implied; the one pre-ledger dossier (WP-2026-0010) is declared, not hidden. badf-build advances VALIDATED -> SHADOWED; admission (BLD-E) is the operator's decision.
business_value: SHADOWED means the controls were run against real cases and behaved; for badf-build the real cases are BADF's own sixty-five builds, judged by the tools it built -- and the honest statement of which controls history could not exercise is what the admission must carry.
in_scope: examples/build-shadow-evidence.json (generated from history; case classes request-digest-bound, authority-replayed, typed-binding-recomputed, fresh-verification-replayed, dossier-not-on-ledger; counts as measured; non_coverage; runner citations)
skills/badf-build/evidence/shadow-evidence.md (honest first sentence, measurement table, non-coverage, why the root stays below ACTIVE until BLD-E)
GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0088.json; own composition record + typed self-dossier; reconcile the land-time-current WP
out_of_scope: any gate, schema, compose or workflow change (ladder-internal)
adding the generator to the repo (the tests are the tool)
acceptance_criteria: every request-digest-bound case recomputes at its landing; every authority case replays from the demand record; every typed binding recomputes MATCH; fresh-verification verdicts replay with zero PASS_WITHOUT_RECORD
the tamper test refuses a wrong tree, a wrong verdict and a case class that cannot be recomputed offline
non_coverage names C3, C4, C6, C7 and WP-2026-0010; the note names every case class and gap and says the root is SHADOWED pending BLD-E
registry badf-build SHADOWED; CI green on the composed tree

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR
